description: Search fresh GTIN products in the catalog your affiliate can deliver (freshness, permissions and delivery caps apply). Requires your affiliate API key in X-API-Key or Bearer authorization; a sandbox key (cw_sbx_, free at partners.clickwise.net/developers) also works, for text or gtin search, and returns example links that never earn. Returns Clickwise /dl/ tracked links only, created for your affiliate the first time a product is returned. country is required unless gtin is given (then every market carrying that GTIN is searched); offset paginates the currently deliverable subset.
name: search_products
title: Search catalog products
